   slice (e.g. "divested 80.1% after ~108 months", "~$99bn goodwill write-down",
   "no divestiture; assets retained"). One short phrase. If none, "not documented".

# Outcome sub-dossier — the KLX Inc./Aerospace Solutions Group business under Boeing ownership, ~3–5-year horizon (~2021–2023)

> SEC reporting at closing, the realized record is traced through the acquirer's own
> subsequent filings and reputable press. This sub-dossier contains no information
> about how the transaction was structured at closing.

## Public-reporting status after the transaction (feasibility-relevant)

- The acquired entity, KLX Inc., filed a Form 15-12B on 2018-10-19 to terminate its
  Exchange Act registration and reporting obligations, listing one (1) holder of record
  (Boeing) as of that date; KLX filed no subsequent Form 10-K or other periodic report
  under its own name. [SRC: SEC accession 0001104659-18-062897, Form 15-12B dated 2018-10-19]
- Because the acquired business became a wholly owned subsidiary reported only within
  Boeing's consolidated financial statements, any realized-record fact for the
  ~2021–2023 window depends on whether Boeing's own periodic filings separately
  disclose that business's results. [SRC: SEC accession 0001104659-18-062897, Form 15-12B dated 2018-10-19]

## Whether the acquirer separately discloses the acquired business (checked within the window)

- Boeing's Form 10-K for the fiscal year ended 2021-12-31 (filed 2022-01-31) contains no
  occurrence of "KLX" or "Boeing Distribution Services" in its filed text (checked by
  full-text search of the fetched filing document); the acquired business is not called
  out as a separate reporting segment, line item, or named subsidiary result anywhere in
  that filing. [SRC: SEC accession 0000012927-22-000010, Boeing Form 10-K, FY2021]
- Boeing's Form 10-K for the fiscal year ended 2019-12-31 (filed 2020-01-31), just
  outside the fixed window on the early side, references "KLX Inc." only inside
  structured XBRL context tags tied to business-combination/purchase-accounting
  disclosures (e.g., a stub period from the 2018-10-09 acquisition date through
  2018-12-31), not in narrative discussion of ongoing performance. [SRC: SEC accession 0000012927-20-000014, Boeing Form 10-K, FY2019]
- No Boeing segment reporting structure that names the acquired Aerospace Solutions
  Group business, KLX, or "Boeing Distribution Services" as a distinct disclosed unit
  within the ~2021–2023 window was located. [SRC: SEC accession 0000012927-22-000010, Boeing Form 10-K, FY2021]

## Organizational placement noted in reputable press (context only, largely predating the fixed window)

- Trade press reported that, effective 2019-02-04, the acquired entity's operating name
  was changed from "KLX Aerospace Solutions" to "Boeing Distribution Services Inc.";
  this predates the fixed ~2021–2023 outcome window and is not itself a realized-record
  scalar. [SRC: https://www.fastener-world.com/en/article/6423.html]
- Aviation trade press (dated 2020-01-30, also predating the fixed window) reported that
  Boeing was integrating the former KLX Aerospace Solutions business with its existing
  Aviall distribution business under a unified "Boeing Distribution Services" branding,
  citing a Boeing representative's statement that this would "streamline" combined
  "presence along with... processes and operations." [SRC: https://aviationweek.com/mro/aviall-name-phasing-out-boeing-further-integrates-distribution-services]

## Items noted but not primary-verifiable within the window

- No company- or Boeing-issued disclosure isolating the former KLX/Aerospace Solutions
  Group business's revenue, net income, headcount, or any other performance scalar for
  fiscal years 2021, 2022, or 2023 was located. [UNVERIFIED]
- Whether any divestiture, material impairment, or restructuring specific to the former
  KLX/Aerospace Solutions Group business occurred within the ~2021–2023 window could not
  be determined from the sources reviewed. [UNVERIFIED]

## Outcome summary (realized record only)

- The acquired entity deregistered from SEC reporting at closing and no subsequent
  Boeing periodic filing checked within the fixed ~2021–2023 window (the FY2021 Form
  10-K) separately names or discloses results for the acquired business as a distinct
  unit; consequently no realized-record scalar (financial or operational) specific to
  this business within the fixed window is publicly traceable to a primary source. The
  facts above are limited to what the acquirer's own filings and reputable press
  document about the business's reporting and organizational status; nothing here is
  inferred from Boeing's undifferentiated consolidated results. [SRC: SEC accession 0000012927-22-000010, Boeing Form 10-K, FY2021] [SRC: SEC accession 0001104659-18-062897, Form 15-12B dated 2018-10-19]

[SLICE END]
